thread:
olivia-cs: AuroraFin just pinged — SIG/CAIQ bundle due Monday but they're blocked pulling audit exports and want KMS/HSM evidence. They hit repeated 401s and some export latency spikes. Can we (1) extend the deadline, (2) troubleshoot the 401/timeout repro, and (3) prepare the KMS/HSM evidence package? Details below.

mike-eng: Can you paste the exact curl they used + any response bodies/headers?

olivia-cs: Repro steps customer sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-03-01","end":"2026-03-14","format":"jsonl"}'
```
They get intermittent 401 then later a 504. sample snippet from their client logs: 
```
2026-03-10T12:34:56Z aurora-client ERROR export failed status=401 body={"error":"invalid_token"}
2026-03-10T12:35:02Z aurora-client WARN export job id=job_93ab started, payload_size=48MB
2026-03-10T12:40:10Z aurora-client ERROR export failed status=504 body={"error":"gateway_timeout"}
```
They also reported a billing spike tied to retries.

mike-eng: Two quick hypotheses: token scope or exported job collision (they re-POST while a job is still provisioning). 401 suggests token was rejected by auth service — can they share the token last4? Also need response headers (WWW-Authenticate) if present. For timeout, export jobs can hit queue/backpressure; for enterprise customers we have a higher-priority async endpoint.

sarah-sec: From security side we need to collect KMS metadata and HSM attestation for the SIG bundle. Specifically: key IDs, key creation + last rotation timestamps, key material origin (HSM), and the Redwood-signed HSM attestation PDF. I can assemble the following artifacts:
- kms_key_list.csv (key_id, created_at, last_rotation, algorithm)
- rotation_proofs.jsonl (signed timestamps)
- redwood-hsm-attestation-2026-03.pdf (signed by infra security)
Please ask AuroraFin to upload their SIG form to our secure intake (I will generate a presigned S3 upload link). We cannot attach attestation to email.

raul-support: Filing an internal ticket and attaching the logs we have.

jira-bot: Ticket INF-4579 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4579 (summary: aurorafin audit export 401 + sig evidence request)

mike-eng: Temporary mitigation for their immediate need: have them create a dedicated service account key with scope `exports:read` and use that for the export call. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/exports/async?priority=high \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"range":{"start":"2026-03-01","end":"2026-03-14"},"format":"jsonl"}'
```
That hits the enterprise async path and reduces queue time. Also suggest they wait until the job returns a job_id before re-submitting.

olivia-cs: Customer requested an extension to Wed 2026-03-18 for SIG submission if we can supply the attestation + logs by then. Can we confirm?

sarah-sec: We can provide the attestation and KMS metadata by EOD tomorrow and agree to new due date 2026-03-18. I'll generate the presigned upload link and post it to INF-4579.

mike-eng: I'll add a small checklist to the ticket: auth headers, token last4, response headers, job_id, server-side trace ids. Also a config snippet to opt into enterprise async exports for now.

raul-support: Uploaded preliminary log bundle to INF-4579 (see ticket). Also added billing spike notes.

olivia-cs: Thanks team — I'll confirm extension with AuroraFin and paste the upload link when Sarah posts it. :thumbsup: If they still see 401s after switching to service account token we'll capture the response headers and escalate to auth-service oncall.
